cases.scope: unlimited WebSocket display and adjacent hot/normal memory branches
observations: Unlimited: summary and expanded WebSocket show 3 · 不限; buffer 4.0 KiB unlimited; RSS unknown; no false zero limit, percentage or memory threshold warning.
320 dark hot: 230 MiB / 256 MiB, 90%, WS 24 / 24 and textual warnings in collapsed and expanded views.
Normal refreshed: WS 0 / 24 and buffer 0 B / 256 MiB; hot warnings cleared. Enter expands and Space collapses; keyboard focus ring visible.
limitations: Unlimited and hot are synthetic read-only memory responses, not actual pressure.
Other C14 paths, C01–C13, abnormal network and cross-page flows were not retested.
